access_grant_consent_check.name: access_grant_consent_check
access_grant_consent_check.value: ("access_grant"."on_behalf" and "access_grant"."consent_method" is not null and "access_grant"."consent_at" is not null) or (not "access_grant"."on_behalf" and "access_grant"."consent_method" is null and "access_grant"."consent_at" is null)

access_grant_consent_note_check.name: access_grant_consent_note_check
access_grant_consent_note_check.value: "access_grant"."consent_note" is null or ("access_grant"."on_behalf" and char_length("access_grant"."consent_note") between 1 and 200)

api_token_revoker_check.name: api_token_revoker_check
api_token_revoker_check.value: "api_token"."revoked_by" is null or "api_token"."revoked_at" is not null

api_token_manual_revoker_check.name: api_token_manual_revoker_check
api_token_manual_revoker_check.value: "api_token"."revoke_reason" is distinct from 'manual' or "api_token"."revoked_by" is not null

audit_event_project_requires_organisatio.name: audit_event_project_requires_organisation_check
audit_event_project_requires_organisatio.value: "audit_event"."project_id" is null or "audit_event"."organisation_id" is not null

contract_terms_amount_currency_check.name: contract_terms_amount_currency_check
contract_terms_amount_currency_check.value: ("contract_terms"."rate" is null and "contract_terms"."kit_fee" is null and "contract_terms"."per_diem" is null and "contract_terms"."mileage_rate" is null) or "contract_terms"."currency" is not null

contract_terms_rate_basis_required_check.name: contract_terms_rate_basis_required_check
contract_terms_rate_basis_required_check.value: "contract_terms"."rate" is null or "contract_terms"."rate_basis" is not null

contract_terms_guaranteed_hours_basis_ch.name: contract_terms_guaranteed_hours_basis_check
contract_terms_guaranteed_hours_basis_ch.value: "contract_terms"."rate_basis" is null or "contract_terms"."rate_basis" not in ('flat', 'buyout') or "contract_terms"."guaranteed_hours" is null

contract_terms_kit_fee_basis_required_ch.name: contract_terms_kit_fee_basis_required_check
contract_terms_kit_fee_basis_required_ch.value: "contract_terms"."kit_fee" is null or "contract_terms"."kit_fee_basis" is not null

contract_terms_mileage_unit_required_che.name: contract_terms_mileage_unit_required_check
contract_terms_mileage_unit_required_che.value: "contract_terms"."mileage_rate" is null or "contract_terms"."mileage_unit" is not null

contract_effective_period_check.name: contract_effective_period_check
contract_effective_period_check.value: "contract"."effective_from" is null or "contract"."effective_to" is null or "contract"."effective_to" >= "contract"."effective_from"

contract_total_value_currency_check.name: contract_total_value_currency_check
contract_total_value_currency_check.value: "contract"."total_value" is null or "contract"."currency" is not null

invite_email_normalised_check.name: invite_email_normalised_check
invite_email_normalised_check.value: "invite"."email" is null or ("invite"."email" = lower("invite"."email") and "invite"."email" !~ '[[:space:]]' and "invite"."email" like '%_@_%')

legal_hold_release_check.name: legal_hold_release_check
legal_hold_release_check.value: ("legal_hold"."released_at" is null) = ("legal_hold"."released_by" is null) and ("legal_hold"."released_at" is null) = ("legal_hold"."release_reason" is null)

location_toilet_distance_check.name: location_toilet_distance_check
location_toilet_distance_check.value: "location"."accessible_toilet_distance_m" is null or ("location"."accessible_toilet" = 'yes' and "location"."accessible_toilet_distance_m" between 0 and 5000)

location_parking_clearance_check.name: location_parking_clearance_check
location_parking_clearance_check.value: "location"."parking_height_clearance_cm" is null or ("location"."accessible_parking" = 'yes' and "location"."parking_height_clearance_cm" between 100 and 500)

person_company_dates_check.name: person_company_dates_check
person_company_dates_check.value: "person_company"."end_date" is null or "person_company"."start_date" is null or "person_company"."end_date" >= "person_company"."start_date"

person_sensitive_payload_check.name: person_sensitive_payload_check
person_sensitive_payload_check.value: "person_sensitive"."payload" is not null or "person_sensitive"."deleted_at" is not null

project_person_dates_check.name: project_person_dates_check
project_person_dates_check.value: "project_person"."end_date" is null or "project_person"."start_date" is null or "project_person"."end_date" >= "project_person"."start_date"

setting_value_layer_project_check.name: setting_value_layer_project_check
setting_value_layer_project_check.value: ("setting_value"."layer" = 'org' and "setting_value"."project_id" is null) or ("setting_value"."layer" = 'project' and "setting_value"."project_id" is not null)
